headline: Vote on up to $3,000,000 in revenue bond anticipation notes for the Tidewater Phase 1B Project.
summary: The agenda includes a public input session and a vote on a note resolution for the Tidewater Phase 1B Project. The resolution covers issuing and selling the notes and the deposit and use of incremental state economic activity taxes.
items: Vote on note resolution authorizing issuance and sale of Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency (Tidewater Phase 1B Project) Revenue Bond Anticipation Notes in one or more series, up to $3,000,000 in total
Addresses other matters, including the deposit and application of incremental state economic activity taxes
location: Pawtucket City Hall, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor
